description: Which car-hire desks at an airport are still open when the person lands: each company's own measured closing time, sorted into open / closes within 45 minutes of landing / already closed, the 24-hour desks, the typical late pick-up fee and a search link timed to reach the desk. Use for late or night flights ('we land at 23:40, who is still open?').

airport.description: Airport id, IATA code or name, e.g. 'faro', 'FAO', 'Faro Airport'

arrival_time.description: Optional landing time, local, e.g. 23:40. Without it: every company's closing time, latest first.

name: desks_open
title: Desks open
